analysis: The supplied units are base and head text excerpts of docs/architecture/inference.md. The file_changes patch shows documentation-only edits: a scheduler config table update (prefill chunk, step tokens, solo-prefill stripe, bidirectional media chunk ceiling), changed ranges near head lines 1087-1146, and edits at head 2028-2041. No executable code, auth, attestation, encryption, or wire-protocol logic changed in the supplied evidence. The units I examined are the base tail (lines 1638-2078) and the head start (lines 1-415). They contain extensive descriptions of the Nemotron Super managed slot, native MiMo, and prefix cache. I could not confirm that these specific passages are among the changed lines, because the head excerpt covers only lines 1-415 and the visible changed head ranges (1087-1146, 2028-2041) fall outside it. I found no statement that weakens a documented control. The documented controls include coordinator-authored cache scope, SSD prefix cache HMAC lookup tags and the 30-minute TTL (T-041), per-request media memory reservations, and the authenticated local application. The prefix-cache description in the head text (cache scope partitioning, image identity hashing, with no scope meaning cold and no publish) is consistent with T-041 scoping and does not widen the at-rest surface. The performance defaults the patch changes (wider prefill chunks for GPT-OSS, dense Qwen3.5/3.8 and Gemma 4) are an availability and memory-admission concern. The docs state that bidirectional media prefill is capped at 512 and that memory admission is unchanged, but I cannot verify that against code here. Remaining questions for integration: whether the underlying code change (EngineV2Factory+Configuration.swift) keeps GlobalKVCacheBudget accounting correct for the wider activation workspace, and whether the new defaults affect T-029 or T-010 behavior. Neither is verifiable from this documentation-only batch. No finding is warranted.
